item.title: 1D STEP-GENDEC-CN
item.description: 1D-STEP-GENDEC-CN is a 1D coupled process-based model developed for Sahelian herbaceous savannas. It simulates a set of processes describing the water, C and N cycling between the atmosphere, vegetation, and soil at daily temporal resolution
